subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw expose `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in `web_search` provider while Firecrawl's public Search API docs still require bearer authentication?
rationale: The code is narrowly implemented and live no-auth search currently works, but the PR creates a public provider id and anonymous hosted query route whose privacy and upstream-support contract are maintainer policy decisions.

options.title: Require Explicit No-Auth Acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers accept the anonymous Firecrawl Search boundary or the upstream documents no-auth Search as a supported contract.

options.title: Accept Live Behavior As Sufficient
options.body: Merge the opt-in provider after rebase and green checks, accepting that OpenClaw owns the risk if Firecrawl later enforces bearer auth.

options.title: Defer Keyless Search
options.body: Close or pause this provider and keep Firecrawl search credentialed until a sponsored product decision revisits it.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit No-Auth Acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers accept the anonymous Firecrawl Search boundary or the upstream documents no-auth Search as a supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the narrowed merged Firecrawl keyless implementation and are the best history-backed owner for deciding whether search should expand beyond that accepted boundary.
